recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source change is needed for FHIR-22988 unless a future build regression reintroduces an Id column into the generated value-set registry table.
issue_request: FHIR-22988 was a Published FHIR-I change request resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. The reporter asked why the first tab of the FHIR value-set registry had an Id column whose values did not match the ValueSet.id values in XML/JSON/Turtle; the approved resolution said the column was merely the tail of the artifact OID, unclear, rarely useful, and should be removed.
initial_application: No core-source commit mentioning FHIR-22988 was found. The current source page source/terminologies-valuesets.html is active narrative for the value-set registry and delegates the table to the <%valuesetslist%> generator include. Published-page comparison shows the requested application did occur by R5: R4 had Name, Definition, Source, and Id columns, while R5 and the current build have only Name, Definition, and Source.
additional_context: FHIR-I January 2020 WGM minutes record Grahame's explanation that the Id column showed the end of the OID for the value set and was not useful, with an 8-0-0 Persuasive with Modification motion to remove it. source/fhir.ini still has an active [valuesets] section feeding the generated registry. FHIR-40545 surfaced in a column-heading search but concerns the ConceptMap registry, not this value-set registry.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative current build surface for terminologies-valuesets.html already reflects the approved removal, and the remaining core source page contains only the active narrative shell plus generator placeholder rather than a stale Id-column definition to edit.

related_jiras.note: Surfaced in a column-heading search, but it concerns ConceptMap table headings rather than the value-set registry and was not decided here.
